note: parser round 32: a single-field tuple variant whose field is skipped on a side is a unit variant on that side in every enum representation (serde effective_style), and the request view no longer counts it as a data variant; an Option inside a flattened newtype around a map is read through the flat buffer; garde length / range bounds written in parentheses or through a macro_rules group are documented; a defaulted const parameter is filled with its default for self-references; a same-spelled const inside another definition body no longer matches the definition's own component (such a self-reference reached through another definition is materialised instead of a $ref).
